provenance: Static geometry estimated from the private dock crop. Magnification is a low-confidence visual fit to a private 640x360 web-video excerpt; replace with direct measurements when available. Source display scale and dock preferences are unknown.

measurements.method: Visual pixel-coordinate estimates from the unmodified crop; divide lengths by two for the current 48px icon prototype. This is a design normalization, not an assertion of source display scale.
measurements.uncertainty: Approximate (+/- 2 source pixels for shelf edges, several pixels for artwork bounds). Icon artwork has varying intrinsic padding; crop contains no dock preference or DPI metadata.

measurements.method: Decode using presentation timestamps; visually inspect native frames and enlarged nearest-neighbor crops. 195 decoded video frames at nominal 24000/1001 fps; container nb_frames=293 is inconsistent with decoded frames and is not used.
measurements.fit: Scale samples at distance 0,1,2,3 icon slots: 1.75,1.50,1.20,1.00. Entry progress visually approximated by 0,.2,.6,.85,1 across roughly four frame intervals. Exit shares this provisional fit; its precise trigger/easing cannot be isolated from pointer motion.
measurements.uncertainty: Low confidence: approximately +/-2 pixels on tiny compressed artwork; at least +/-2 frames (~83ms) on transition estimates. Icon padding varies, cursor is difficult to resolve, recording preferences and playback fidelity are unknown. Neighbor samples and interpolation are an approximation, not an exact reference curve.

measurements.source: User comparison against an accessible modern dock
observations: Entry and exit should feel quicker than the initial prototype
Magnification should stay active across gaps between icons
measurements.method: Provisional subjective adjustment based on user feedback, not a frame measurement. Keep the existing sampled progress curves; revisit with direct reference recordings.
measurements.uncertainty: Modern comparison system, settings, and exact durations are unspecified; these defaults are a trial fit, not measured Mavericks timing.

measurements.method: User-requested equal 130 ms entry and exit for evaluation; subjective tuning, not a reference measurement.

measurements.source: Provisional interaction prototype authorized for iterative tuning
measurements.method: Tooltip styling approximates the observed dark single-line labels. Delay 0 means no added wait, not a measured reference delay. Bounce uses an engineering sample arc, not a measured or remembered Dock curve. Height 14px, period 480ms, and launch timeout 10s are trial values.
measurements.limitation: Plasma task demand-attention state has no informational/critical classification; prototype uses one bounce per attention request and a persistent indicator. Repeat startup bounce until startup clears or pending launch times out.

measurements.source: User correction of launch feedback behavior
observations: Launching an app always produces one complete bounce
Further bounces only while the app is still loading
Stop repeating when a running or active window appears, even if startup data lags
measurements.implementation: Remove the local pending-launch repeat timer. The click starts one cycle; backend startup state permits additional cycles. Finish the current cycle when startup completes. Bounce geometry and timing remain provisional.

measurements.source: User tuning request after live launch tests
measurements.method: Two-thirds of the previous speed means 1.5 times the cycle duration. Preserve the running arc across startup-to-window task replacement; complete the current cycle on readiness.

adjustment.shadow: heavy black blur with downward offset

measurements.method: User requested text-only labels at 1.5–2 times the original prototype size. Chosen size is 1.75 times 12px. Shadow parameters are provisional visual styling, not measured font metrics.
Double the shadow blur radius and use matching bold glyphs in the label and shadow. Enlarge label bounds/padding to avoid clipping.
User-requested visual comparison; preserve bold weight and shadow settings.
Interpret bringing the label down by about 50% as halving its gap above the icon.

measurements.source: User semibold and closer label tuning
measurements.method: Anchor the text line bottom rather than the shadow container above the icon. Gap is now measured from the font descent; subjective user tuning, not reference measurement.
Add 4px to the previous 2px text-line-to-icon gap after live visual feedback.

measurements.source: User label size and spacing refinement
measurements.method: Explicit point size requested by user; keep semibold weight and text-line placement.
Use 16 pixels rather than 16 points; retain 9px gap and semibold weight.
Double blur radius and composite an additional half-opacity shadow pass for approximately 50% more density; enlarge shadow bounds and surface headroom.

measurements.source: User requested much darker label shadow
measurements.method: Four times the previous broad-shadow pass weight plus two tight-core passes. Alpha compositing saturates, so perceived darkness is judged visually rather than claimed as a linear fourfold change.
Reduce both blur radii by 20 percent; retain shadow density, font size and label spacing.

measurements.source: User requested smaller shadow source instead of smaller blur
measurements.method: Restore earlier blur radii and scale only the source glyph mask to 80 percent around the text line center. Visible label retains its size and placement.

measurements.source: Engineering prototype for auto-hide; no reference measurement available
measurements.method: User-requested smooth rise and expansion from 80% size, reversed on hide. Provisional 400 ms cubic ease-in/out; not measured reference behavior.
